# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

**Excelerate Energy Limited Partnership - First Amendment to Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** August 22, 2022

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Excelerate Energy Limited Partnership, a Delaware limited partnership, operates as an LNG infrastructure company with vessel operations including LNG storage and regasification services.

**Transaction Description:** This transaction represents a first amendment to an existing senior secured revolving credit agreement originally dated April 18, 2022. The amendment involves Excelerate Energy Limited Partnership as borrower, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent, and a syndicate of seven institutional lenders including Barclays Bank PLC, Morgan Stanley Bank N.A., Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, Wells Fargo Bank, BOKF NA, and First Financial Bank.

**Purpose of Financing:** The amendment facilitates modifications to the existing credit agreement to accommodate a specific transaction - the "Finland Charter Purchase" - involving the disposition of the vessel "Exemplar" by Exemplar, LLC to Floating LNG Terminal Finland OY pursuant to a purchase option exercise under a Time Charter Party and LNG Storage and Regasification Agreement dated May 20, 2022.

**Company Background:** Excelerate Energy operates in the LNG infrastructure sector with vessel-based operations. The company maintains a fleet of vessels (referenced as "Vessels" in the agreement) and has subsidiary operations including Excelerate Energy Finland, LLC. The business involves LNG storage, regasification services, and vessel chartering arrangements.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

**Key Strengths/Credit Positives:**
• **Diversified Lender Syndicate** - Strong institutional lender group including major banks (JPMorgan Chase, Barclays, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo)
• **Asset-Backed Security** - Senior secured facility with liens and security interests securing payment obligations
• **Proactive Capital Management** - Automatic commitment reduction of $150 million upon vessel disposition demonstrates disciplined capital allocation
• **Established Operations** - Operating LNG infrastructure with contracted revenue streams (Finland charter agreement in place)
• **No Covenant Defaults** - Borrower representations confirm no defaults or events of default existing as of amendment date

**Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:**
• **Vessel Concentration Risk** - Business dependent on vessel operations; mitigated by diversified fleet and contracted charter arrangements
• **Commodity Exposure** - LNG market cyclicality and commodity price volatility; mitigated by contracted charter revenues
• **Regulatory Risk** - Maritime and energy sector regulatory requirements; mitigated by required insurance coverage and compliance reporting
• **Counterparty Risk** - Dependence on charter counterparties; mitigated by institutional counterparty (Floating LNG Terminal Finland OY)
• **Liquidity Risk** - Revolving credit structure requires ongoing covenant compliance; mitigated by senior secured position and institutional lender support

**Company Background:** Excelerate Energy operates in the LNG infrastructure sector with vessel-based operations. • **Vessel Concentration Risk** - Business dependent on vessel operations; mitigated by diversified fleet and contracted charter arrangements

• **Regulatory Risk** - Maritime and energy sector regulatory requirements; mitigated by required insurance coverage and compliance reporting
• **Counterparty Risk** - Dependence on charter counterparties; mitigated by institutional counterparty (Floating LNG Terminal Finland OY)
• **Liquidity Risk** - Revolving credit structure requires ongoing covenant compliance; mitigated by senior secured position and institutional lender support
